title: Clicking an invoice deleted or reversed after the report loaded shows the standard not-found state and back returns
custom_preconds:
1. The report is open with an invoice detail row visible.
2. In another tab/session, that invoice is deleted or reversed AFTER the report loaded (do not refresh the report).
custom_steps:
1. Back in the report (unrefreshed), click that invoice's number link.
2. Read the destination page, then press the browser back button.
custom_expected:
1. The destination page shows the application's standard "not found" state.
2. Pressing back returns you to the report.
